Path-qualify the changelog's bare markdown citations so the site can open them

The docs site check holds every cited markdown file of ours to a link.
Six bare names in the #81, #82 and #83 entries (`SWITCH.md`, `AUDIT.md`,
`REFACTOR.md`, `ORCHESTRATION.md`, `EVAL2.md`, `STATUS.md`) resolved
against neither the root nor a directory, so they rendered as grey text
and `site/build.py --check` failed on main. Each now carries its
`training/` path; the sentence that quoted a bare name on purpose says
so in prose instead.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01HAKZSeYkdhHtYHtekycbGL

import re, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("CHANGELOG.md"); s = p.read_text()
before = s
# Only lines 110-170 carry the bare names; restrict the rewrite to that window.
lines = s.split("\n")
win = "\n".join(lines[109:170])
new = re.sub(r"(?<![/\w])`(SWITCH|AUDIT|REFACTOR|ORCHESTRATION|EVAL2|STATUS)\.md`", r"`training/\1.md`", win)
new = new.replace(
"- The #80 entry cited `training/EVAL2.md` without its path, which\n  `tests/test_docs.py` reads as a missing file; it now says `training/EVAL2.md`.",
"- The #80 entry cited the eval-2 pre-registration by its bare filename, which\n  `tests/test_docs.py` reads as a missing file; it now says `training/EVAL2.md`.")
lines[109:170] = new.split("\n")
p.write_text("\n".join(lines))
